nodes.text: Bigger work. The ford eats well, so the ford bargains badly. Four head of cattle off Amberford's pastures and the winter leans our way. The Charter will hate you for it — that's not a side effect, that's the product.

choices.text: The herd's as good as gone.
I don't make war on cattle.

nodes.text: Quietly, if you can. Loudly also works. The arithmetic doesn't care.
Cattle, wardens — it's all somebody's herd. But suit your stomach.
